text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - Serving cluster prod-eu-1 reporting RDMA packet-loss surge -> GPU driver timeouts -> container restarts. Endpoint affected: /v1/chat/complete. Auto-page: oncall-sam.

oncall-sam: offline briefly, joining. seeing alert floods: rdma_retransmit and mlx5 qps resetting. paging @sre-kira and @net-infra-ash.

sre-kira: I'm looking. NVML shows repeated "NVML_ERROR_GPU_IS_LOST" on pods bound to n-12,n-13. kernel logs show `mlx5_core: qp 0x2a2d: retry count exceeded`.

eng-runtime-lee: fyi we have CPU-only fallback pool but it has limited capacity; using it will drastically increase median latency. what's scope?

ops-priya: traffic graph: prod-eu-1 accounts for ~30% of global requests. Error rate for /v1/chat/complete: 12% 5xx over last 5m; tails spiking to >10s. shifting to fallback will raise p50 from 90ms -> ~700ms.

net-infra-ash: switch sw-eu-7 reporting flaps on ports 5-8. Counters: rx_err 1800, link_down 12 in last 10m. possible bad optics or microburst. Raising vendor ticket now.

vendor-support: Received VND-11042. Quick check: recommend QSFP reseat + check firmware mismatch between adjacent switches. Also ask SRE to capture IB counters with `ibv_devinfo` and `rdma link` stats.

incident-bot: Automation: downgraded route weight for prod-eu-1 to 40% at 08:12Z. Some sessions persisted on stuck nodes.

sre-kira: trying temporary mitigation: reduce concurrent inflight per-pod and shrink batch windows to reduce RDMA bandwidth. Patching configmap `serving-config` batch.max_tokens=32 -> 8 and batch.window_ms=100 -> 30.

eng-runtime-lee: recommend also limiting `max_concurrency` from 20 -> 6 for pods on region eu-1. can roll this selectively to nodes tagged nic-ib to limit blast radius.

ops-priya: applied configmap patch to daemonset `serving-rlm` on eu-1. Rolling restart started for pods on n-10..n-15. command snippet: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-rlm -n prod --selector=region=eu-1`.

incident-bot: Change applied by ops-priya at 08:21Z. CI checks passed.

sre-kira: memory churn down but still seeing 1-2 pods OOM per node due to previous leaked caches. I'm cordoning n-12 and draining to force reschedule to healthier nodes.

ops-priya: cordon+drain: `kubectl cordon n-12 && kubectl drain n-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` -> drain completed. Pods rescheduled; new pods land on n-18 which has IB path to region backbone.

net-infra-ash: vendor on call confirmed port flaps likely caused by a marginal QSFP on sw-eu-7: port 6. hardware team reseated and swapped QSFP at 08:34Z. monitoring.

vendor-support: after QSFP swap, observed decrease in link flaps. Recommend keep monitoring for 20 minutes and check for error re-emergence. Also escalate firmware plan if issue recurs.

customer-success-zoe: we have two enterprise customers reporting increased latency and retries; one flagged failed requests. Need short note for them.

eng-runtime-lee: short blurb: "We observed RDMA network instability in eu-1 causing GPU driver timeouts and a small number of container restarts. We throttled batching/concurrency and shifted some traffic; error rates have dropped and hardware team performed an optics swap. We'll follow up with a full incident report."

customer-success-zoe: sending that now.

sre-kira: post-swap: IB retransmit counters trending down by 85% within 8m. No new NVML driver errors after 08:42Z. Pods previously OOMing are stable.

incident-bot: Alert cleared at 08:45Z. Monitoring window: 1h.

oncall-sam: good work. next actions: 1) SRE to own postmortem with packet captures and timeline (owner: sre-kira), 2) Net infra to validate firmware versions across spine/switches (owner: net-infra-ash), 3) Ops to run chaos test for auto-shift behavior during similar RDMA degradation (owner: ops-priya).

sre-kira: I'll upload logs and `dmesg` extracts to IMP-196600 and include sampled NVML logs and `ibv_devinfo` outputs.

net-infra-ash: adding firmware audit to infra backlog and scheduling vendor follow-up for next week.

customer-success-zoe: customers acknowledged initial message and will wait for incident summary.

eng-runtime-lee: will open eval to ensure batching change did not alter model outputs meaningfully.

oncall-sam: closing here, thanks all :thumbsup:
